title: CaliCraft Cobblemon Modpack
body:
CaliCraft Cobblemon Modpack

The official modpack for CaliCraft's Cobblemon server. Built on top of the official Cobblemon modpack with additional mods required to play on our server.

Features
- **Cobblemon** - Catch, train, and battle over 700 Pokémon
- **Radical Cobblemon Trainers** - 1500+ NPC trainers that spawn naturally in the world
- **Cobbleloots** - Loot balls scattered throughout the world with Pokémon rewards
- **Performance mods** - Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and more for smooth gameplay
- **QOL mods** - Minimap, recipe viewer, better UI, and visual enhancements

How to connect
1. Install this modpack through Prism Launcher
2. Add server: **CaliCraft.mc.gg**
3. Type `/server cobblemon` to join the Cobblemon world
